'''Droid Fusion''' is a mechanic in Droid Tycoon released in v1.27. Droid Fusion allows the player to combine 3 droids to obtain 1 better variant/rarity or an new droid entirely.

== About ==
Droid Fusion can be unlocked after reaching [[Rebirths|Rebirth]] 3. The Fusion lab is located between the workshop area and the landing bay of the players base. 

The player can select three crafted droids to be combine. To select a droid you will first have to manually select Fusion in the droid menu. The selected droids will stand on top of a fusion table. If three droids are placed on the table, a little screen will show if a fusion is able to proceed. If the player proceeds, all three droids will vanish from your possesion. 

The droid that the player receives will first have to be crafted in the Fusion Tank. The player can speed the crafting time up by using their pickaxe (similar to regular crafting) and by using D-O as companion droid. The player can not fuse droids if a droid is still being crafted in the Fusion tank. The player can buy a second fusion tank for 300 Nova Crystals at the Nova Shop.

There are currently 17 unqiue droids that can only be obtained via Droid Fusion. The player will need the exact droids that are required to obtain a new droid. The placement of these droids can be random on the table. Each droid has their variant, the variant of droids can be obtained if the variant of droid that was placed on the fusion table. For example: Placing 2x Gold Mouse with one Gold ARG will reward the player with a Gold WHL-EX. The player can mix different variants, the droid that will be obtained after Fusion will be the lesser variant: For example: 1x Rainbow Mouse, 1x Beskar Mouse and 1x Stellar ARG will reward a Rainbow WHL-EX since rainbow is the lowest variant.

The player can also upgrade a droid to it's next variant. Placing three common Mouse droids on the table will reward one Gold Mouse. Placing three Gold Mouse will reward a Diamond Mouse etc.

The player can also combine several random droids from the same rarity. For example placing a ARG, B-U4D, and NAV-EX (all Rare droids) will reward a random Epic droid.
